claims.content: The External Traffic System retrieves published RLCS status information, including lane status, customer restrictions, access conditions, and sign messages, from an external server outside the RLCS network.

goal.raw_text: The External Traffic System retrieves published RLCS status information, including lane status, customer restrictions, access conditions, and sign messages, from an external server outside the RLCS network.

claims.content: External Traffic System
An external server outside the RLCS network (outside a firewall) must be available and accessible to the External Traffic System.
The external server data store containing RLCS status must be updated at least once per minute prior to retrieval.
The RLCS system must have published lane status, customer restrictions, access conditions, and sign messages to the external server.
The External Traffic System initiates a request to access RLCS data through the Department of Transportation ISSC resource interface (one-way output only).
The system connects to the external server located outside the RLCS network firewall.
The External Traffic System retrieves the single data file containing RLCS status information.
The system parses the retrieved file to extract lane status, customer restrictions, access conditions, and sign messages.

If the Department of Transportation ISSC resource interface is unavailable, the External Traffic System may alternatively connect via a secure remote dial-in interface through a firewall using a dial-up modem, which allows two-way connection into the RLCS network with authorized user logon.
The External Traffic System has successfully retrieved the single data file containing RLCS status information from the external server located outside the RLCS network firewall.

The retrieved data file contains the required data elements: Status (e.g., open northbound, open southbound, closed), Customers (e.g., RLCS/FasTrak only, all traffic), Access (e.g., location 1 open, location 2 closed), and Signs (e.g., Sign 1 'Express Lanes Open').
The external server data store containing the retrieved RLCS status has been updated at least once per minute.
